data.narrative:
Saltfoss Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Troels Schonfeldt that has raised $40M+ to date. The valuation universe for this analysis comprises 11 total comparables across the nuclear energy sector: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Fuse Energy, Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and General Matter.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total capital raised ($40M) as a base proxy, a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the next financing stage implies a valuation of $80M. The peer-median approach, while supported by a 4-company nuclear energy comp set, could not be applied due to insufficient narrow-filter matches (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier peers). Deploying all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable bias given the specialized nature of frontier nuclear technology.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $68M to $92M, with a median point of $80M. This range reflects the single-method triangulation and inherent model uncertainty. Key risks include limited comparability within early-stage nuclear technology companies, founder-dependent execution risk, and regulatory pathway variability. The reliance on a single methodology underscores the need for updated peer data as the sector matures and additional private round disclosures emerge.
